notes: Editing a group in the Clients tab no longer redraws the whole tab. Creating, renaming or deleting a group called selectTab("clients_hub"), which rebuilds everything: an open filter panel collapses, a half-typed inline edit is thrown away and the scroll position jumps to the top, all to add one line to a table of groups. The tab's existing in-place table refresh does not cover this on its own -- it rebuilds a row only when that client's own fields changed, and creating a group changes no client, so every row would keep the group list it was built with, missing exactly the group just created. So the four places a group change actually reaches are patched directly: the group select on each row, the filter's group select, the count in mini-stats, and the group table itself. Deleting is the case that also moves clients (the server returns them to No_Group) and the in-place refresh handles that, running first so the option lists are patched over the result. Filtering by a group that is then deleted no longer leaves the filter pointing at something gone -- it falls back to all groups and the filter state is resynced, so the table and the control driving it cannot disagree.
